sample_unit: critical care pharmacists (semi-structured interviews; 104 case discussions)
models_evaluated: AI-based vancomycin dosing clinical decision support system (Mayo Clinic)

links.outcome: Pharmacist acceptance of AI vancomycin dose recommendations after reveal (algorithm aversion)
links.effect: Pharmacists' empiric doses differed from the CDSS in 88/104 (85%) cases; after reveal, 69/88 (78%) remained discrepant and pharmacists would not alter their recommendations.
links.quote: In discrepant cases, pharmacists indicated they would not alter their recommendations.

screen.reason: The study conducts qualitative interviews and vignette-based testing with critical care pharmacists to assess perceptions, trust, and acceptance/uptake of an AI clinical decision support system for vancomycin dosing.
